```{=html}
<script>
  (() => {
    const list = document.querySelector("#question-list");
    const tagButtons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".tag-filter-button"));
    const clearTagFilters = document.querySelector("#clear-tag-filters");
    const status = document.querySelector("#question-bank-status");
    const cards = Array.from(list.querySelectorAll(".question-card"));

    function updateQuestions() {
      const selectedTags = tagButtons
        .filter((button) => button.getAttribute("aria-pressed") === "true")
        .map((button) => button.dataset.tag);
      cards.forEach((card) => {
        const cardTags = card.dataset.tags.split(" ");
        const matches = selectedTags.length === 0 || selectedTags.every((tag) => cardTags.includes(tag));
        card.hidden = !matches;
        list.append(card);
      });

      const count = cards.filter((card) => !card.hidden).length;
      clearTagFilters.disabled = selectedTags.length === 0;
      status.textContent = `${count} question${count === 1 ? "" : "s"} shown${selectedTags.length ? ` for ${selectedTags.length} selected tag${selectedTags.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}` : ""}.`;
    }

    tagButtons.forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const selected = button.getAttribute("aria-pressed") === "true";
        button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(!selected));
        updateQuestions();
      });
    });
    clearTagFilters.addEventListener("click", () => {
      tagButtons.forEach((button) => button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false"));
      updateQuestions();
    });
    updateQuestions();
  })();
</script>
```


## Graph Dictionary

| Term | Definition |
|---|---|
| Node/Vertex | A point in the graph. |
| Edge | A connection between two vertices. |
| Degree | The number of edges connected to a vertex. |
| Path | A sequence of vertices connected by edges, with no repeated edges. |
| Connected | Every vertex is reachable from every other vertex. |
| Component | A maximal connected subgraph. |
| Complete graph K_n | A graph in which every vertex is connected to every other vertex; it has n(n-1)/2 edges. |
| Planar graph | A graph that can be drawn in 2D without edge crossings. |
| Euler path | A path that uses every edge exactly once. |
| Euler circuit | An Euler path that starts and ends at the same vertex. |
